notes.title: More than a Metroidvania. A Personal Story
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey, everyone![/b]
I'm wrapping up a new demo for [i]Tootum[/i] that will soon be available for you to test! Before that, I wanted to clarify a few things — especially for those who played the first demo or are just now discovering the game.[/p][p][i]Tootum[/i] still holds its original essence: it's a metroidvania focused on exploration and precision platforming. Combat has been greatly improved, and the [b]Enchantress[/b] — our magical, talking sword — continues to play a central role in the story. That hasn’t changed.[/p][p]Many new mechanics have been added to make exploration even more exciting and the platforming challenges more fun. My goal has always been to turn [i]Tootum[/i] into a great metroidvania. That’s been my personal challenge.[/p][p]Someday, maybe I’ll share all the struggles I went through to make this game. Because the truth is — there's a story inside the game... and another one behind it, which is mine. That’s what makes [i]Tootum[/i] special to me — and it’s what I hope you’ll feel when you play it.[/p][p]I don’t know if I’ll succeed in conveying all of this, but I’ve set out to try. To create a game that shows, in one way or another, the importance of never giving up.[/p]

notes.title: Tootum – A solo journey crafting a metroidvania with heart
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

As many of you already know, I’m a solo indie developer with a long-time dream: to create an amazing metroidvania. I've been studying and working hard for years to make it happen, and I’m pouring all my passion into Tootum – a project where I put all my heart, creativity, and effort.

I’ve been funding everything out of my own pocket, and I’m fully committed to finishing the game later this year so everyone can enjoy this action-packed and discovery-filled adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188357/5c8af60599339de4fdd0e1a3ada029bd2a10b011.png[/img]

Over the past few months, Tootum has gone through major improvements: I redesigned the main character, rewrote parts of the story, added new combat mechanics, power-ups, worked on the map, and polished many other aspects. With each test, I feel the game getting better and closer to the experience I always envisioned.

Oh, and about the demo – I’ve taken it down because it became outdated and no longer represents the current gameplay. I want your first impression to reflect the real experience of what Tootum has become.

I truly hope you’ll enjoy playing it as much as I’ve enjoyed making it. Thanks for being part of this journey! ❤️
